title: Vintage Soviet Film Camera Workshop
summary: Discover Soviet film camera history before heading outdoors for a guided photography walk using your own Smena film camera.
description: Begin with an accessible introduction to the history of Soviet photography and the development of widely used cameras such as the Smena, Zenit, FED, Zorki, Kiev and Chaika.

Participants will learn about the differences between Soviet camera types, how basic manual film cameras operate, and why these cameras became such recognisable objects of twentieth-century photographic culture.

After the introduction, the group will head to a predetermined area in Singapore for a guided photography walk. The location may change depending on the workshop date, accessibility, weather considerations and the photographic theme of the session.
imageAlt: A vintage Smena film camera prepared for a guided photography workshop
programme: Welcome and introduction to the workshop.
Brief history of Soviet photography and camera production.
Introduction to different Soviet camera types and manufacturers.
Basic camera controls, film handling, focusing and exposure guidance.
Hands-on preparation using a Smena or equivalent film camera.
Guided photography walk around a predetermined area in Singapore.
Closing discussion, questions and practical advice for continuing with film photography.
inclusions: One Smena film camera or an equivalent Soviet film camera for each participant.
Historical and practical introduction to Soviet film cameras.
Guided assistance with basic camera operation.
A guided photography walk in Singapore.
The camera and film may be brought home after the workshop.
